provenance.protocol: archived greedy 16-env 60000/80000, warmup64, ridge1e-6, seed45 streams200/201

protocol.history_shuffle: one permutation of all non-reset tokens within each complete original episode; recompute strict10 windows; original targets and classes
protocol.random_input: one replacement draw per non-reset position from empirical non-reset token pool in that split, preserving reset; original targets/classes
protocol.bootstrap: 1000 episode-cluster resamples; probes fixed; recompute test-class means; init and paper checkpoints
protocol.pooled_r2: 1 - sum class SSE / sum class SST (test-class means)
protocol.scalar_split: b_j/(b_j+b_l), j<l are the two non-Bayes-winner coordinates
protocol.null_space: null of W[0]-W[2], W[1]-W[2], rank2, dimension62
